resources.string: Everyday controls stay visible while expert details stay collapsed.
Show all diagnostics, profiles, and low-level settings.
Your settings stay on this device. Your traffic can go through the servers that come with this app.
This app comes with servers, rules, and settings in place. You can change them later on the Connection and Settings tabs.
Tap Connect on the Status tab. Android may ask for permission to create a local VPN. To disconnect, tap the button again and confirm.
Tap Connect on the Status tab. RIPDPI starts a local proxy and shows its address there. Only apps that you point to it use it. To disconnect, tap the button again and confirm.
Open the Diagnostics tab and tap Check network. It shows where the connection fails. You can share the summary with the person who gave you this app.
Routes all apps through an on-device VPN. Android asks for permission first.
Runs a local proxy for apps or clients that support manual proxy configuration.
The selected mode could not be validated.
Allow notifications so RIPDPI can show validation service status.
VPN permission was denied, so RIPDPI could not validate VPN mode.
Start the selected mode and verify that RIPDPI can route traffic correctly.
Android may ask for permission before RIPDPI can create a local VPN tunnel. No remote VPN server is used.
Android requires permission before RIPDPI can create a local VPN tunnel on this device. No remote VPN server is used.
RIPDPI needs permission from Android to create a VPN tunnel on this device.
Android will ask for permission to create a local VPN connection.
Android will ask for VPN access so RIPDPI can route traffic through its local tunnel. RIPDPI uses the servers in your active configuration.
Grant Android VPN permission to keep RIPDPI running locally on this device.
Allow notifications to show RIPDPI status and service alerts while the local VPN or proxy is running.
Notification permission is still blocked. Open app settings and allow notifications for RIPDPI.
Allow RIPDPI to ignore Android battery optimization so Doze is less likely to interrupt the local VPN or proxy in the background.
Some devices add extra background limits beyond Android battery optimization. If RIPDPI stops in the background, review the app battery or background usage settings.
Xiaomi/MIUI devices may block RIPDPI from running in the background. Go to Settings > Apps > Manage apps > RIPDPI, set Battery saver to No restrictions and enable Autostart.
Huawei devices may stop RIPDPI in the background. Go to Settings > Battery > App launch, find RIPDPI, disable automatic management, and enable Auto-launch, Secondary launch, and Run in background.

OnePlus devices may aggressively stop background apps. Go to Settings > Battery > Battery optimization, find RIPDPI and select Don\'t optimize. Also disable Deep Optimization and Sleep Standby Optimization if available.
Use biometric authentication before opening the main dashboard on this device.
Only biometric authentication is configured for this device right now.
Use the fallback PIN stored on this device if biometric authentication is unavailable.
Digits only. The PIN is checked locally and never leaves this device.
The backup PIN does not match.
No fingerprint or face is set up on this device. Unlock with your device PIN, pattern, or password.
This device has no fingerprint, face, or screen lock, so RIPDPI cannot verify you. Set up a screen lock in system settings to protect the app.
This action needs access to your local network. Internet connections remain available without this permission.
Allow Nearby devices in app settings, then retry this action.
RIPDPI checks your network path and improves how your traffic is sent, with a local VPN or proxy on this device.
Android asks to allow notifications when the test starts. RIPDPI shows one while the local VPN or proxy runs.
The test starts a proxy on this device. Only apps that you point to it use it, and Android does not ask for VPN permission.
